atoms.b: You press the stop button on a bus before ((++your every)) stop.

We can find bus timetables ((++online in_the_chimney)) and at the ((++bus_stop road)).

instruction.text: Listen to the statements and decide which is true.

b.sound: You can use a booster seat so that the seatbelt works properly.
You only have to use a booster seat when you are over the age of 12.
You should always try to get in and out of a car from the pavement.
You should always try to get in and out of a car from the road
Seat belts must be worn at all times while travelling in a car.
You can choose if you want to wear a seatbelt.
